look: Prism Warden, a D-rank GKOM variant from the Prism Wardens family: faceted crystal sentinel with a healing green light at its centre. Family anatomy: floating faceted light-spirits and prism sentinels built of rotating crystal plates. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystals crust its joints and run along the spine; about a quarter of the body crystallised; the crystals are green-gold prism crystal. A tennis-ball-sized GKOM core orb, dark amber with visible cracks, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Light: warm gold, white and soft rose accents, modest sun motes, feather-like light and halo rings
